experiment_data.hypothesis: 72B 3-shot few-shot NER will show reduced output diversity compared to zero-shot (higher degeneracy) due to in-context examples constraining output space, while improving greedy baseline F1. The key diagnostic question: does few-shot improve LP-F1 alignment (enabling construction) or does increased degeneracy negate any calibration gain? This fills the zero-shot vs few-shot vs fine-tuned regime comparison for the scaling section. Parent: exp_qwen25_72b_zeroshot (negative — LP near-zero, high degeneracy in ZS).
